bioconda.name: oxbreaker
bioconda.summary: GTK4 GUI wrapper that launches a Nextflow pipeline
bioconda.description: OxBreaker is a GTK4-based interface that collects parameters and launches a Nextflow pipeline. The package bundles the Nextflow project files and assets so they are available at runtime.

build.script: -m pip install . -vv && mkdir -p "$PREFIX/share/oxbreaker" && cp "$RECIPE_DIR/oxbreaker.desktop" "$PREFIX/share/oxbreaker/oxbreaker.desktop" && ( [ ! -f "$RECIPE_DIR/oxbreaker.png" ] || cp "$RECIPE_DIR/oxbreaker.png" "$PREFIX/share/oxbreaker/oxbreaker.png" ) && mkdir -p "$PREFIX/bin" && cp "$RECIPE_DIR/oxbreaker-desktop-helper" "$PREFIX/bin/oxbreaker-desktop-helper" && chmod +x "$PREFIX/bin/oxbreaker-desktop-helper"
